result:
All data verified. Here are the final answers:

---

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162` (construction via `s3presign.NewRunner`), `:163` (initial `RunOnce`), `:166-170` (goroutine running periodic `Run`).

**h02.** Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`; protection mechanism — `safeDialContext` (dial-time DNS re-resolution + reserved-IP rejection) at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, plus registration-time `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`, both checking against `reservedCIDRs` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14`.

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` at `internal/idp/idp.go:3`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol, at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

**h04.** No; the MySQL driver is only constructed in the `NewDBDriver` factory at `store/db/db.go:22`. A codebase-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB` in non-test Go files returns only that single hit.

**h05.** Explicit Go code; the user-deletion transaction calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions created by the user). Evidence: `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102`; `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:383,401`; `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:420,438`. No `ON DELETE CASCADE` on the reaction table in any migration SQL.

**h06.** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`); convergence function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07.**
- `serveUserAvatar` (HTTP handler) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` → `driver.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `parseDataURI` (decodes base64 avatar from `User.AvatarURL`) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:738`

**h08.** Two declarers:
1. `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked: yes — callers: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`) and `Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
2. `memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked from production code: no

**h09.** 6 distinct declarations: `SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`). Invoked directly by non-test server code: `Store.Close` by `Server.Shutdown` (`server/server.go:146`); `SSEHub.Close` by `Server.closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:206`). (`Cache.Close` and the DB-driver `Close` are called transitively from `Store.Close` at `store/store.go:74-78`.)

**h10.** `Engine.CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — approx 34 callers (38 call sites across filter helpers, attachment service, shortcut service, and all three DB-driver memo_relation files, plus test callers).

**h11.** 1st (tie): `Memo` and `User`, each referenced from ~6 packages outside `store/`. Memo: server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/fileserver, server/router/frontend, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload. User: server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/api/v1/test, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss. 3rd: `Attachment` (~4 packages).

**h12.** `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`; determination: `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets the default, the factory at `store/db/db.go:18-20` maps `"sqlite"` → `sqlite.NewDB`, and `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`.

**h13.** Impl: unexported `service` struct at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57`. Construction: `markdown.NewService()` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), called from `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`). Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` (calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`memo_service.go:447`), `Runner.RunOnce` batch rebuild (`runner.go:52`). Extracted properties: `tags` (hashtags), `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_task_list`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title` (first H1 heading).

**h15.** Enforcement sites:
- `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- `ListMemoComments` filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:157`
- `CreateMemoComment` access check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33`
- `ListMemoReactions` check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82`
- `ListMemoAttachments` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:421`
- `checkAttachmentViewPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674`
- RSS feed filter — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Sitemap filter — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- SSE hub `canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`

**r01.** False premise: there is no Redis. The cache is a pure in-memory `sync.Map` implementation at `store/cache/cache.go`. Three caches (instance settings, users, user settings) are created with a 10-minute default TTL at `store/store.go:40-53`.

**r02.** False premise: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The server registers only panic-recovery and CORS middleware (`server/server.go:50-53`). No rate limiting exists anywhere in the codebase.

**r03.** False premise: there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The scheduler package at `internal/scheduler/` exists but is never used by the server to register any cleanup job. The only background runner is the S3 presign URL refresher.

**r04.** False premise: there is no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128) at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, drained by 4 goroutines spawned in `init()` that call `Post()` directly via HTTP.

**r05.** False premise: there is no GraphQL API. The public API is defined via Protocol Buffers (`.proto` files in `proto/api/v1/`) and served over gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON) and ConnectRPC, registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.
